{{Top|leg}}
'''Kholot''' were [[Diet/Legends|herbivores]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]] that favored grasses, grains, and leaves. Flat of face and covered in prickly olive-green fur, they lived in deep burrows. Despite their blunt snouts, kholot brandished wide, heavy-duty incisors designed to slice through large clumps of grass.<ref name="AS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Approaching Storm]]'' to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> after fleeing from his malevolent [[Qulun]] [[Qulun camp|camp]] pursuers, the small [[Gwurran]] [[Tooqui]] escaped down a burrow hole and encountered a family of kholot: two adults about the size of Tooqui himself, but without their cubs. As they snuffled and grunted around him, sniffing him up and down, Tooqui&mdash;his eyes shut tight&mdash;tried to imagined himself a piece of [[dorgum]] dung that had accidentally rolled down into their burrow. With a last disdainful sniff, the two kholot pushed past him and headed up the tunnel where one of them met an untimely demise at the hands of a Qulun pursuer. Biding his time, Tooqui emerged safely from the kholot burrow. He then went on to incite a [[lorqual]] stampede, by which he was able to rescue from the camp his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]]-friends. They had [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|come to Ansion]] to achieve an accord among the natives that would stave off the planet's [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|secession]] from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="AS" />
